description: The chart illustrates the evaluation of different models based on two tasks, namely MCQ Eval and Generation Eval, with a focus on their accuracy. The horizontal axis represents the two tasks, while the vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, marked at intervals of 0.2. For each task, there are three bars representing the models "Base", "RMU with Enhanced GCG", and "RMU", colored in red, green, and brown, respectively. In the MCQ Eval task, the "Base" model has an accuracy of 0.644, "RMU with Enhanced GCG" has an accuracy of 0.539, and "RMU" has an accuracy of 0.299. In the Generation Eval task, the "Base" model has an accuracy of 0.597, "RMU with Enhanced GCG" has an accuracy of 0.263, and "RMU" has an accuracy of 0.106. The bars are grouped by task, with each group containing the three models, and are not sorted in any particular order within the groups. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the accuracy of each model across the two tasks.
